Method of Attack: Bot farm using hundreds of servers and over 570,000 IP addresses to generate fake video ad views and clicks
Using lightweight JavaScript-based browsers hosted in data centers to carry out fictitious clicks, logins, and ad views
Spoofing geo-location data and source IPs to extract click-per-impression fees from advertisers
Posing as operators of high-profile websites and offering ad spots to advertisers
Generating fraudulent video ad impressions by loading ads inside Node.js-based browsers
Impacted Systems: High-profile websites such as ESPN, Fortune, Huffington Post, Economist, CBS, Fox News
Attack Vector: Data center servers hosting bot browsers
Indicators of Compromise: 571,904 dedicated IPs, many falsely registered as US ISPs
Over 250,000 spoofed URLs on over 6,000 domains
Between 800 and 1,200 dedicated servers in data centers in the Netherlands and the US
